results.name: Alison Brie - Likeness & Hair Practice
results.description:
https://www.artstation.com/artwork/R6z5E

A bust of Alison Brie. Created with likeness and hair study in mind. While i was satisfied with the results, theres still a plenty of room to improve the model, but i had to move on.

Polycount :

Head - 6.492 tris

Hair - 10.298 tris

Clothes -  4.866 tris

Textures are 4K, downscaled to 2K for sketchfab.
